dedupe_keys.name: red ferroviaria lineas bta 1 10000 del ano 2011

description: Red Ferroviaria (Líneas). BTA 1:10000 del año 2011 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idem.comunidad.madrid. Theme of the Harmonized Topographic Base of the year 2011 (BTA10M+) v1.0, scale 1:10.000 that includes both the communication tracks for trains and funiculars, as well as the associated infrastructures. Railways and cable-suspended transport, among others, have been included. It comprises the central part of the Community of Madrid. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Railway Network (Lines). BTA 1:10000 of 2011" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Tren, Ferrocarril, Tranvía, 2011, Comunidad de Madrid, Cable. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
